table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	CustomerGroup = (SELECT CG.Name FROM CustomerGroup CG WHERE CG.CustomerGroupCode=:ll_CustGroupCode),
	itemname=I.name, 
	itemalias=I.customicode, 
	GroupName= 
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
	CustomerAlias=(Select Ac.AliasName FROM accounts Ac Where Ac.Acccode = A.CustCode),
	customer=(Select Ac.Name FROM accounts Ac Where Ac.Acccode = A.CustCode),
	Address=(Select RTRIM(LTRIM(isnull(C.Address1,''))) + ' ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(isnull(C.Address2,''))) FROM Customer C Where C.CustCode = A.CustCode),
	City=(Select isnull(C.CITY,'') FROM Customer C Where C.CustCode = A.CustCode),
	qty=Sum(A.qty),
	returnqty=Sum(A.returnqty),
	saleamount=Sum(A.saleamount),
	saleretamount=Sum(A.saleretamount),
	netamount=Sum(A.amount),
	salebonusqty=sum(A.salebonusqty),
	retbonusqty=sum(A.retbonusqty),
	Stock=(select isnull(sum(godowndetail.currqty), 0) from godowndetail 
			where godowndetail.icode=I.icode and gcode IN 
				(select case :as_AllGodown WHEN 'Y' THEN gcode ELSE :ai_gcode end from godown))
FROM
	Item I,
	(SELECT	dbo.saledetail.icode,
		qty= Sum(dbo.saledetail.looseqty),
		returnqty=0,
		salebonusqty=sum(dbo.saledetail.bonusqty),
		retbonusqty=0,
		amount   = Round(Sum ( (dbo.saledetail.looseqty + dbo.saledetail.bonusqty) * dbo.saledetail.saleprice), 2),
		saleamount=Round(Sum ( (dbo.saledetail.looseqty + dbo.saledetail.bonusqty) * dbo.saledetail.saleprice), 2),
		saleretamount=0,
		dbo.saleledger.custcode
	FROM 	dbo.saleledger, 
	 	dbo.saledetail, 
	 	dbo.item
	WHERE	dbo.saleledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	 	dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	 	dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (SELECT CustCode FROM CustomerGroupDetail WHERE CustomerGroupCode=:ll_custgroupcode) AND
	 	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN dbo.item.manfcode
		WHEN 'C' THEN dbo.item.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN dbo.item.ICCode
		ELSE dbo.item.PACKCODE END IN (:ll_groupcode) and
		dbo.saledetail.gcode IN (select case :as_AllGodown WHEN 'Y' THEN saledetail.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode end from godown) AND
	 	dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode  
	GROUP BY
		saledetail.icode,
		dbo.saleledger.custcode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT	sd.icode,
		qty= Sum(sd.looseqty),
		returnqty=0,
		salebonusqty=sum(sd.bonusqty),
		retbonusqty=0,
		amount   = Round(Sum ( (sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty) * sd.saleprice), 2),
		saleamount=Round(Sum ( (sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty) * sd.saleprice), 2),
		saleretamount=0,
		dbo.saleledger.custcode
	FROM 	dbo.saleledger, 
	 	dbo.saleinvdetail sd, 
	 	dbo.item
	WHERE dbo.saleledger.impactinventory='N' AND
		dbo.saleledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	 	dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	 	dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (SELECT CustCode FROM CustomerGroupDetail WHERE CustomerGroupCode=:ll_custgroupcode) AND
	 	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN dbo.item.manfcode
		WHEN 'C' THEN dbo.item.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN dbo.item.ICCode
		ELSE dbo.item.PACKCODE END IN (:ll_groupcode) and
	 	sd.gcode IN (select case :as_AllGodown WHEN 'Y' THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode end from godown) AND
		sd.icode = item.icode 
	GROUP BY
		sd.icode,
		dbo.saleledger.custcode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	dbo.srdetail.icode,
	 	qty      = 0,
		returnqty=(-1 * Sum(dbo.srdetail.looseqty)),
		salebonusqty=0,
		retbonusqty=(-1 * sum(dbo.srdetail.bonusqty)),
		amount   = (-1 * Round(Sum ( (dbo.srdetail.looseqty + dbo.srdetail.bonusqty) * dbo.srdetail.srprice), 2)),
		saleamount=0,
		saleretamount=Round(Sum ( (dbo.srdetail.looseqty + dbo.srdetail.bonusqty) * dbo.srdetail.srprice), 2),
		dbo.srledger.custcode
	FROM
		dbo.srledger, 
		dbo.srdetail,    
		dbo.item
	WHERE
		dbo.srledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		dbo.srledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	 	dbo.srledger.custcode IN (SELECT CustCode FROM CustomerGroupDetail WHERE CustomerGroupCode=:ll_custgroupcode) AND
		dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode and  
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN dbo.item.manfcode
		WHEN 'C' THEN dbo.item.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN dbo.item.ICCode
		ELSE dbo.item.PACKCODE END IN (:ll_groupcode) and
		dbo.srdetail.icode = item.icode AND
		srdetail.gcode IN (select case :as_AllGodown WHEN 'Y' THEN srdetail.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode end from godown) 
	GROUP BY 
		srdetail.icode, 
		dbo.srledger.custcode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT	saledetail.icode,
		qty= Sum(saledetail.looseqty),
		returnqty=0,
		salebonusqty=sum(saledetail.bonusqty),
		retbonusqty=0,
		amount   = Round(Sum ( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) * saledetail.saleprice), 2),
		saleamount=Round(Sum ( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) * saledetail.saleprice), 2),
		saleretamount=0,
		saleledger.custcode
	FROM dbo.crs_saleledger saleledger, 
	 	dbo.crs_saledetail saledetail, 
	 	dbo.item
	WHERE	
		saleledger.clientinstanceid = saledetail.clientinstanceid AND
		saleledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	 	saleledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	 	saleledger.custcode IN (SELECT CustCode FROM CustomerGroupDetail WHERE CustomerGroupCode=:ll_custgroupcode) AND
	 	saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and  
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN dbo.item.manfcode
		WHEN 'C' THEN dbo.item.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN dbo.item.ICCode
		ELSE dbo.item.PACKCODE END IN (:ll_groupcode) and
		saledetail.gcode IN (select case :as_AllGodown WHEN 'Y' THEN saledetail.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode end from godown) AND
	 	saledetail.icode = item.icode  
	GROUP BY
		saledetail.icode,
		saleledger.custcode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	srdetail.icode,
	 	qty      = 0,
		returnqty=(-1 * Sum(srdetail.looseqty)),
		salebonusqty=0,
		retbonusqty=(-1 * sum(srdetail.bonusqty)),
		amount   = (-1 * Round(Sum ( (srdetail.looseqty + srdetail.bonusqty) * srdetail.srprice), 2)),
		saleamount=0,
		saleretamount=Round(Sum ( (srdetail.looseqty + srdetail.bonusqty) * srdetail.srprice), 2),
		srledger.custcode
	FROM
		dbo.crs_srledger srledger, 
		dbo.crs_srdetail srdetail,    
		dbo.item
	WHERE
		srledger.clientinstanceid = srdetail.clientinstanceid AND
		srledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
		srledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	 	srledger.custcode IN (SELECT CustCode FROM CustomerGroupDetail WHERE CustomerGroupCode=:ll_custgroupcode) AND
		srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and  
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN dbo.item.manfcode
		WHEN 'C' THEN dbo.item.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN dbo.item.ICCode
		ELSE dbo.item.PACKCODE END IN (:ll_groupcode) and
		srdetail.icode = item.icode AND
		srdetail.gcode IN (select case :as_AllGodown WHEN 'Y' THEN srdetail.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode end from godown) 
	GROUP BY 
		srdetail.icode, 
		srledger.custcode) AS A
WHERE
	A.icode = I.icode
GROUP BY 
	A.CustCode,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.PackCode,
	I.name,
	I.customicode,
	I.Icode
ORDER BY
	Customer,
	GroupName,
	I.name,
	I.Icode
